title: Add plugin builds to pretest script
body:
CI test failure in `packages/runner/src/plugin-integration.test.ts` due to missing dist artifacts for `@object-ui/plugin-kanban` and `@object-ui/plugin-charts`.

The test imports these plugin packages:

```typescript
import { kanbanComponents } from '@object-ui/plugin-kanban';
import { chartComponents } from '@object-ui/plugin-charts';
```

But the pretest script only built core packages (types, core, react, components), leaving plugin packages unbuilt.

## Changes

- Extended `pretest` script to build `@object-ui/plugin-kanban` and `@object-ui/plugin-charts` before test execution
